StackType.rationale: PowerStackType.Counter. The sim has no StackType concept; Power.on_stack adds unconditionally, which is what PowerCmd.ModifyAmount does (PowerCmd.cs:236 -- no StackType branch). Third-file citations, not hashed here.

AfterAttack.issue: NARROWED 2026-07-27, and a NEW residual is recorded. THE HOOK IS FIXED: SuckPower now implements `after_attack(dealer, card, results)` (powers.py:1720-1734), the sim's Hook.AfterAttack bracket, and `hooks.after_attack` hands it AttackCommand.Results as the (receiver, unblocked) pairs DamageCmd.deal accumulates (hooks.py:555-567, cmds.py:190-194). It counts the connecting hits and applies `self.amount * hits` ONCE after the attack, so the mid-attack self-boost (Fossil Stalker LASH 3x2 dealing 9 where the game deals 6) and the killing-blow skip are both gone. WHAT REMAINS: SuckPower.cs:23's third early-return condition, `!command.DamageProps.IsPoweredAttack()`, is no longer expressed anywhere -- the sim's after_attack bracket carries no props (hooks.py:555) and powers.py:1727 tests only the dealer and the receiver's side. Dormant today: the owner is an enemy and `Monster._execute_attack` (monsters/base.py:117-128) always brackets powered MOVE damage. Named trigger: any unpowered damage dealt inside an attack bracket by a Suck owner. This record's group-counting guard is untouched and still open.

guards.what: SuckPower.cs:32-36 the pet de-duplication (RemoveAll on the pet owner's results)
guards.rationale: Pets/Osty belong to the other characters; in Ironclad scope each hit group has one receiver and the de-duplication is a no-op.

guards.what: Counting GROUPS with unblocked damage, not individual results
guards.issue: C#'s `num` counts outer lists (per-hit result groups) in which ANY result had unblocked damage, so a single AoE hit that connects with three creatures counts 1. The sim's per-hit hook counts every connecting RESULT, so the same AoE would grant 3x. Folded into the hook entry's rollup; carried separately because it survives an after_attack-slot fix. Dormant: the Fossil Stalker has no AoE move (monsters/underdocks/fossil_stalker.py -- TACKLE, LATCH and LASH are all single-target).
